name: How many fit?
rule: Dividing by a unit fraction asks 'how many pieces fit?' Dividing by 1/4 means times 4. Dividing by 1/8 means times 8.
why: There are 4 quarters in 1, so there are 6 × 4 quarters in 6. Dividing by a small piece gives you MORE pieces.

clues: How many pieces of size 1/{d} fit in 1 whole?
There are {d} of them in each whole, so you are multiplying by {d}.
Dividing by 1/{d} is the same as times {d}.
